rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The page introduces the address of '8日の公明党臨時全国代表者会議で選出された山口那津男・新代表', who says that having just received the delegates' confidence he has been chosen as 公明党代表 ('ただいま皆さまの信任を賜り、公明党代表に選出されました').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The address, headed 山口那津男　代表, continues 'as new representative' ('新代表として') and offers a greeting on taking office ('代表就任にあたり、一言、ごあいさつを申し上げます').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: In the same address he thanks '太田前代表' and the former secretary-general for steering the party for three years.
